content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD main program file (header L3 'FILE main.F', BSD license L5-43). PROGRAM FUNWAVE_TVD (L45) with a VERSION 3.0 flow-chart comment (L47-68), a unit-number convention comment ((1) input, (2) output, (3) log, (4) hotstart; L70-72) and a hot-start data layout comment listing dimensions, time, spacing, physics, numerics, wet-dry, depth, variables and wavemaker data (L73-134). Uses GLOBAL (L136), conditional VESSEL/SEDIMENT/FOAM/METEO/TRACKING/PRECIPITATION modules (L138-157), TIDE_MODULE and TIME_SPECTRA_MODULE (L159-160). Sequence: MPI_INIT (L168), READ_INPUT (L177), TIME=HotStartTime if INI_UVZ (L188-190, ykchoi 14.12.24), INDEX (L193), ALLOCATE_VARIABLES (L204), INITIALIZATION (L214), TIME_SPECTRA_INITIAL if WaveMaker=='TIME_SPECTRA' (L218-220), TIDE_INITIAL (L222), TIME_SPECTRA_PROTECTION (L224-227), TIME=TIME_COUPLING_1 under COUPLING (L238), module initials VESSEL_INITIAL/METEO_INITIAL/SEDIMENT_INITIAL/ALLOCATE_FOAM+INITIALIZATION_FOAM/PRECIPITATION_INITIAL/TRACER_INITIAL (L242-264), wall-clock start via MPI_Wtime or CPU_TIME (L278-281). Main loop DO WHILE(TIME<TOTAL_TIME) (L284): OUTPUT first to capture initial condition (L288, comment 11/27/2018), SOLITARY_WAVE_LEFT_BOUNDARY for LEF_SOL (L290-292), save Eta0/Ubar0/Vbar0 (and SEDIMENT CHH0) (L295-300), EXCHANGE (L313), OneWayCoupling (L316), ESTIMATE_DT(Mloc,Nloc,DX,DY,U,V,H,MinDepthFrc,DT,CFL,TIME) (L320), U0=U/V0=V saved after DT for Ut,Vt computation (L331-332, ykchoi 15.08.06), VESSEL_FORCING/METEO_FORCING (L335/L339), TIDE_DATA when TideBcType=='DATA' (L350-352), TIME_SPECTRA_INTERPOLATION (L362-364), PRECIPITATION_DISTRIBUTION (L376); then 3rd-order Runge-Kutta DO ISTAGE=1,3 (L380): Cal_Dispersion if DISPERSION (L382-384), FLUXES (L394), SourceTerms after fluxes to get eta_t (L404), ESTIMATE_HUV(ISTAGE) (L414), UPDATE_MASK moved inside RK (L417), TIDE_BC if TIDAL_BC_ABS (L419-421), SEDIMENT_ADVECTION_DIFFUSION(ISTAGE) (L432), WAVE_BREAKING (L435), FOAM_FLUX/FOAM_UPDATE/FOAM_BC (L446-448), EXCHANGE (L451), OneWayCoupling (L462), ABSORBING_GENERATING_BC for ABS or TIME_SPECTRA (L466-467), IRREGULAR_LEFT_BC for LEFT_BC_IRR (L479-481), SPONGE_DAMPING if DIRECT_SPONGE (L483-485); after RK: MORPHOLOGICAL_CHANGE if Bed_Change (SEDIMENT, moved out of RK 07/02/2019, L491-493), MIXING_STUFF (L496), TRACK_XY (L507), MAX_MIN_PROPERTY when any OUT_Hmax/Hmin/Umax/MFmax/VORmax/Time (L513-515), CHECK_BLOWUP (L517). After loop: final STATIONS or STATIONS_SPHERICAL_IJ flush (L537-544), CLOSE(11) under COUPLING (L548), close vessel units 201..200+NumVessel (L553-555), wall time end and 'Simulation takes'/'Normal Termination!' messages to stdout and unit 3 (L560-575), MPI_FINALIZE (L578), END PROGRAM (L581). Trailing comment block (L584-648) defines variable meanings (Depth/DepthNode/DepthX/DepthY, Eta/Eta0, MASK/MASK_STRUC/MASK9, U/V as depth-averaged or u_alpha, HU/HV, P/Q as HU/HV+dispersion at interfaces, Fx/Fy/Gx/Gy, Ubar/Vbar, U1p/V1p, EtaRx/y L/R, Hx/y L/R, HUx/y L/R, PL/PR/QL/QR) and flux formulas FxL=HUxL*UxL+1/2*g*(EtaRxL^2+2*EtaRxL*Depthx) etc. (L640-648).

unresolved: Duplicated DEBUG block: CHECK_BLOWUP progress message printed twice (L519-525 and L527-533) — copy-paste duplication, no second call.

Hot-start comment block (L73-134) describes unit 4 read/write of dimensions/time/physics/variables, but no hot-start read/write code exists in this file; INI_UVZ + HotStartTime (L188-190) is the only hot-start mechanism visible here.
Header comment 'MASK_STRUC(): 0 - permanent dry point' (L600) and 'MAST_STRUC' typo in the hot-start list (L123).
Trailing definitions block says Ubar(:,:,:) 3-dimensional (L613-614) while init.F allocates Ubar(Mloc,Nloc) 2-D — stale comment relative to code.
DEBUG message at L473 has doubled word 'wavemakerwavemaker'.

OUTPUT is called at the top of the loop (L288) before the first time step, and station buffers are flushed after the loop only via STATIONS call (L537-544) whose flush condition is TIME>=TOTAL_TIME inside io.F.
